scope: isolated local public-code demonstration; NOT federal contract or production performance

window.clock: UTC timestamps; monotonic durations for window/recovery

deployment_frequency.unit: verified local release transitions per observation window

samples.acceptance: four completed, downloaded exports with expected fixture counts
four completed, downloaded exports with expected fixture counts
four completed, downloaded exports with expected fixture counts

deployment_frequency.definition: A running release transition counts only after four authenticated exports complete and download. Baseline, cutover and rollback count; bootstrap/health-only starts, commits, PRs and same-revision incident restarts do not. No per-day extrapolation.

lead_time_for_changes.definition: Mean Git committer timestamp to first verified LOCAL deployment in this window, once per unique runtime source revision. Includes idle time; not coding time, merge-to-production time or labor saved.

samples.acceptance: all four authenticated export formats downloaded and matched baseline

demo_mttr.definition: Mean first observed Failed authenticated export to all four fresh authenticated exports downloaded and matched baseline after an intentional exporter stop/restart. Includes the scripted 2-second isolation check. Not production MTTR.

labor_hours_saved.reason: No measured manual baseline, comparable task cohort, human touch-time or quality-adjusted rework data

mission_efficiency_change.reason: No operational users, mission outcome baseline or comparable mission workload

production_deployments.reason: No production telemetry or deployments performed

velocity.reason: No sprint cadence, estimates or historical accepted story points; demonstration backlog is not velocity

limitations: One host, one seeded observation and one seeded location; not load, scalability, resilience or HA evidence.
Exporter shares MongoDB, file stores and core MAGE adapters. Not independently owned data or a fully decoupled estate.
Failed jobs remain Failed; recovery verifies newly submitted jobs, not automatic replay.
No continuous government tool access, deployment history or production observability is established by a saved demo report.
Short-window deployment counts and one intentional fault do not predict steady-state DORA performance.
